units.source_text: “我从未见过像现在埃及首都开罗和亚历山大港实行的闺房仪式那样，使女人的身体变得那么美丽、那么轻盈的东西。

en.t: I have never seen anything that makes a woman's body so beautiful and so light as the boudoir ritual now practiced in Cairo, the capital of Egypt, and in the port of Alexandria.

units.source_text: 任何妇女只要实行六个月，身体大概都会发生判若两人的好变化。

en.t: If any woman practices it for six months, her body will probably change for the better so much that she seems like a different person.

units.source_text: 多亏有了特莱密夫人的倡导，埃及妇女才得以逐步体味到再生的喜悦。”

en.t: Thanks to Madame Ptolemy's advocacy, the women of Egypt have gradually come to taste the joy of being reborn.
